subject.title: [Bug]: Runtime tool surface returns blank body after gateway-touching operations; container restart only briefly clears it

question: Should maintainers treat the remaining reports as a distinct gateway/session-lifecycle wedge that needs live log triage, or is https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 sufficient proof for this issue after validation?
rationale: Static source review cannot prove whether the open aggregate-recovery patch covers the gateway-touching, session-scoped wedge reported across Telegram and webchat, and the issue is already labeled to avoid a new autonomous fix PR before maintainer triage.

options.title: Hold for live wedge triage
options.body: Use the reporter-provided live sessions and redacted gateway logs to distinguish lock/admission/projection/bridge failure before creating or accepting a fix for this issue.

options.title: Validate the open aggregate patch against this issue
options.body: Run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 against the reported gateway-touching repros and keep this issue open unless the blank-body wedge stops reproducing.

options.title: Split a narrower follow-up
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 fixes only prompt projection, keep this issue for gateway/session lifecycle recovery and link the prompt-projection issue separately.

recommendation.title: Hold for live wedge triage
recommendation.body: Use the reporter-provided live sessions and redacted gateway logs to distinguish lock/admission/projection/bridge failure before creating or accepting a fix for this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest current-main history for the central session/gateway files routes through steipete, and this needs a maintainer-level proof decision before automation should attempt repair.
